title: std::filesystem::directory_iterator::operator++, std::filesystem::directory_iterator::increment
summary: Advances the iterator to the next entry. Invalidates all copies of the previous value of *this.
html:
directory_iterator& operator++();
 (1) (since C++17)
directory_iterator& increment( std::error_code& ec );
 (2) (since C++17)

Advances the iterator to the next entry. Invalidates all copies of the previous value of *this.

This section is incomplete

Parameters

ec - error code to store error status to

Return value

*this

Exceptions

Any overload not marked noexcept may throw std::bad_alloc if memory allocation fails.

1) Throws std::filesystem::filesystem_error on underlying OS API errors, constructed with the OS error code as the error code argument.
2) Sets a std::error_code& parameter to the OS API error code if an OS API call fails, and executes ec.clear() if no errors occur.
